bug_info.bug_desc: In the old code, addr_cnt_d is initialized to 30 for 4-byte addresses and 22 for 3-byte addresses when the read-command FSM leaves MainReset. This is one beat short of the actual address length, so the address counter reaches zero and MainAddress is allowed to advance to MByte/Dummy/Output one cycle before the final address beat is captured. As a result, the last address byte is not latched or merged, and the captured read address is shifted, causing the wrong SRAM/read-buffer location to be accessed.
bug_info.fix_hint: Initialize the address beat counter to the full number of address beats minus one when entering MainAddress: use 31 for Addr4B and 23 for 3-byte mode, so MainAddress remains active for one additional cycle and the final address beat is latched before the phase advances.
